description: Run a target repo's own pull_request workflows locally BEFORE opening a PR: discovers .github/workflows triggered on pull_request, executes the mappable run steps (tests, lint, typecheck, build) with per-step timeouts, checks repo conventions (changesets, conventional-commit subjects, DCO sign-off), and reports PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED per check with a GO/NO-GO verdict. Steps that cannot run locally (deploys, secrets, publishes) are SKIPPED with the reason named, never passed. Use after building a fix, before pushing. Local execution only; never touches GitHub.

base.description: Base git ref for convention checks (default: auto-detect).

path.description: Local path to the target repo checkout, e.g. /home/user/work/bruno

use_act.description: Run workflows via act+docker when available; falls back to native mode when not.

name: ci_prep
